questions.subject: Mathematics Standard
questions.question: May challenge: During summer bridge and next-session readiness, a Class 10 learner is reviewing Applications of Quadratic Equations. a rectangle has area 48 cm² and length 2 cm more than breadth. Its breadth is:
questions.explanation: Let breadth b; b(b+2)=48 gives b²+2b−48=0, so b=6 (positive root).
